scripts.build: npm run build:theme && npm run validate:footprints && npm run check:search && hexo clean && hexo generate && npm run check:site && npm run check:links
scripts.test: npm run test:pages && npm run check:search && npm run validate:footprints
scripts.build:pages: npm run build && npm run test:pages && node tools/build-pages.js && npm run check:pages
scripts.check:pages: node tools/check-site.js public-pages && node tools/check-links.js public-pages && node tools/check-pages.js
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build && npm run test:pages && node tools/build-pages.js vercel && npm run check:vercel
scripts.check:vercel: node tools/check-site.js public-vercel && node tools/check-links.js public-vercel && node tools/check-pages.js vercel
